map.输入各不确定度分量u_i与对应自由度ν_i，按Welch-Satterthwai: Enter each uncertainty component u_i and its degree of freedom nu_i; compute the combined effective dof nu_eff by the Welch-Satterthwaite formula, for measurement-uncertainty evaluation.
map.输入两组分量不确定度 u、v 及自由度 ν，求有效自由度。: Enter two component uncertainties u, v and degrees of freedom nu to find effective degrees of freedom.
